name: Active Minds
description: Through education, research, advocacy, and a focus on underrepresented populations, "Active Minds opens up the conversation about mental health and creates lasting change in the way mental health is talked about, cared for, and valued in the United States. Active Minds strives to empower students to

name: Afghan Student Association
description: The Afghan Student Association organization is to support and empower fellow Afghan and non-Afghan students within our universities community. This club aims to provide Afghans and non-Afghan students with the opportunity to learn about the culture of Afghanistan. This organization will be supporting the Afghan heritage going through in depth detail about culture, history, and many more. The goal is to create an opportunity for other students to learn about Afghanistan. Overall this club will essentially focus on Afghan culture, history, and promote inclusivity. The club is to foster a sense o

name: African Student Association (ASA)
description: The African Student Association’s purpose is to strengthen, promote and cultivate cultural connections and create community within the African Student Association as well as those with interest in African culture.

name: Alliance for Change
description: Alliance for Change is a social justice-oriented student organization, supporting individuals formerly and currently incarcerated through education, advocacy, and community-building, with the larger goal of seeking initiatives to reform the American Criminal Justice system.

name: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated
description: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated is a service-based organization dedicated to sisterhood, scholarship, and service. We uplift our campus and community through impactful programs, leadership development, and initiatives focused on education, health, the environment and social justice.

name: Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Incorporated
description: To develop leaders promote brotherhood and academic excellence, while providing service and advocacy for our communities.

name: Alpha Phi Omega (APO)
description: Alpha Phi Omega is a national co-ed service fraternity grounded in its core principles of leadership, friendship, and service. Since its founding in 2001, the Alpha Epsilon Nu chapter has helped shape hundreds of lifelong leaders while fostering meaningful, lasting friendships.

name: Alpha Sigma Nu (ASN)
description: Alpha Sigma Nu is the only Jesuit Honors Society allowed to bear the name Jesuit. It teaches and recognizes students who hold the values of ASN: Loyalty, Scholarship, and Service. Its purpose is to recognize students of high academic achievement and provide a community for these students.

name: American Chemical Society Student Chapter
description: Our goal is to foster a community of chemistry enthusiasts and promote the interest of chemistry. We encourage everyone, even if they do not come from a STEM background, to join our club!

name: American Institute for Architecture Students
description: The American Institute of Architecture Students empowers students by fostering leadership, professional development, and advocacy through external partnerships with firms and other chapters in the Bay Area. We focus on growing our network with professionals and the American Institute of Architects.

name: Anime, Culture, and Video Games (AVC)
description: ACV promotes increased awareness, understanding and celebration of anime/animation, culture, and video games. ACV will build a community where lovers of these media may celebrate them. The club will not focus exclusively on the goods from any one country and is open and appreciative of all animation.

name: Arab Student Union (ASU)
description: The purpose of the Arab Student Union is to celebrate, promote, and educate the community about Arab culture, identity, and heritage. The organization aims to create a welcoming and inclusive space for Arab students and allies.

name: Art History Student Association
description: Our mission is to build interest in studying Art History by promoting local artists and art organizations. Our objectives include fostering a dedication to the history and cultural preservation of the visual arts and providing a network of potential career resources for members.

name: Ascend Leadership
description: Ascend Leadership connects students to a nationally recognized network of leaders, mentors, and professionals through leadership development, career-focused programming, and meaningful networking opportunities. While rooted in promoting Pan-Asian leadership and representation, Ascend Leadership welcomes students of all backgrounds who are committed to personal growth, professional development, and making a positive impact in their communities.

name: Aspiring Researchers Association
description: Aspiring Researchers Association (ARA) is dedicated to providing students with opportunities to learn more about academic research as a career pursuit, and for aspiring researchers in the USF community to come together to share their knowledge, connections, and experiences.

name: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
description: ACM is a professional development organization for students with an interest in Computer Science and Data Science. We frequently host networking events, workshops, field trips, and community bonding events.

name: Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM)
description: The purpose of the Association for Women in Mathematics is to create a community in which women and girls can thrive in their mathematical endeavors, and to promote equitable opportunity and treatment of women and others of marginalized genders and gender identities across the mathematical sciences.

name: ASUSF Campus Activities Board (CAB)
description: The ASUSF Campus Activities Board (CAB) is a student-run organization dedicated to planning and coordinating on-campus entertainment and university-wide events that enhance student life, spark involvement, and bring the University community together.

name: ASUSF College Players
description: College Players provides quality theatrical experiences for the community. As a student-led Theatre Company, we are committed to offering training and leadership opportunities in performance, design, technical theater, and more. We provide thoughtful and inclusive spaces for our all.

name: ASUSF Culturally Focused Clubs Council (CFCC)
description: The mission of CFCC is to aid in the development of the university's recognized Culturally Focused Clubs and Organizations and their individual members.

name: ASUSF Graphics Center
description: The Graphics Center is a student-run design firm which provides promotional and design services for student organizations and the University of San Francisco community at large. Specifically, these services intends to serve organizations, and departments at the University of San Francisco.

name: ASUSF San Francisco Foghorn
description: The San Francisco Foghorn is the official student-run newspaper of the University of San Francisco. We cover and report on news topics in an around the USF campus in the scene, sports, opinion, and news sections of our newspaper.

name: ASUSF Senate
description: The purpose of the ASUSF Senate is to act as the representative body of the Associated Students of the University of San Francisco (ASUSF). The Senate will advocate for the needs of ASUSF by serving as a liaison between the Association and the USF administration.

name: ASUSF USFtv
description: USFtv aims to serve the USF community by representing the student voice, providing entertainment, and reporting on USF and San Francisco-related events. We provide educational film sets for students–both media students and not–to learn about the elements of filmmaking.

name: ASUSF Voices
description: ASUSF Voices, USF's largest student choir, gives Dons who share a passion for music the opportunity to perform together. Five unique, student-produced ensembles under the direction of two co-directors, host a variety of events year round, including end-of-semester concerts!

name: Atria
description: Atria connects students through shared experiences, meaningful conversations, and common interests, helping them build lasting friendships, discover new passions, and find a place where they belong.

name: Audio Engineering Society
description: To teach, practice, and apply proper Audio Engineering tactics such as proper signal flow, how to work with a DAW, how to properly record, how to mix, etc. To cultivate a community of Audio Engineers, Musicians, Film Makers, and Creatives that could further serve their community with the skills learned within the club.

name: Badminton Club
description: The purpose of the Badminton Club is to build a welcoming and inclusive space for students to enjoy the sport of badminton whether for recreation or competition. The club encourages participation from all skill levels and seeks to promote personal growth, community building, and the sport itself.

name: Best Buddies
description: Best Buddies is an organization dedicated to creating inclusive communities for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). Our mission is to foster friendships, leadership development, and social opportunities that promote acceptance, connection, and belonging.

name: Beta Alpha Psi
description: As the premier professional business financial information organization, Beta Alpha Psi recognizes academic excellence and complements members’ formal education by providing interaction among students, faculty, and professionals, and fosters lifelong growth, service and ethical conduct. Beta Alpha Psi is an honorary and professional organization for students of accountancy and finance. Its objective is to provide recognition of outstanding academic achievements in the field of accounting and finance; the promotion of study and practice of accounting and finance; the provision of opportunities

name: Bioethics Society
description: Our organization promotes awareness, discussion, and education on bioethical issues in medicine, biotechnology, green chemistry, and scientific research. We provide a forum for students to examine ethics, sustainability, healthcare decision-making, and the societal impacts of innovation.

name: Biotechnology and Bioentrepreneurship Club (BTEC&BIOE)
description: The Biotechnology and Bioentrepreneurship Club shall seek to promote professional development in the field and biotechnology and entrepreneurship.

name: Birdwatching Club
description: Birdwatching Club aims to introduce students to the world of birdwatching. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, learn about nature, make friends, and explore our city’s parks.

name: Black Business Association
description: The purpose of the Black Business Association is to create a culturally affirming professional development community that advances Black student success in business and related fields. The organization seeks to equip students with practical career skills, mentorship opportunities, and exposure to professional pathways while fostering confidence, leadership, and a supportive peer network. Membership and participation are open to all currently enrolled students who support the mission and purpose of the organization.

name: Black Student Union (BSU)
description: To foster community and unity among students open to all on the University campus. Our spaces focus on exploring and examining the identity, history, issues and culture of the Black diaspora. We balance our celebration of Black joy with analysis of our hardships of the community. The org’s focus at its core is to create a holistic sense of community, one not simply rooted in bliss trauma, strife, or fun, but the multi-faceted Black experience.

name: BRIDGE at San Francisco
description: Bridge at San Francisco is a student organization dedicated to fostering open, respectful dialogue on social and political issues. Our mission is to bridge diverse perspectives, encourage critical thinking, and create a welcoming space for meaningful conversations and community engagement.

name: Brother Connection
description: The purpose of Brother Connection is to create a supportive space where students can uplift, grow, learn from, and connect with one another through mentorship, community, and shared experiences. This organization values Brotherhood, Education, and Growth.

name: Cancer Biology Collective
description: Cancer Biology Collective is guided by five core pillars: 1. Explore - Discover academic, professional, research, and healthcare opportunities connected to cancer biology, human health, and biomedical science. 2. Learn - Promote academic success, scientific literacy, and beginner-friendly understanding of cell biology, genetics, immunology, public health, and biomedical research. 3. Experience - Provide hands-on learning, research exposure, case-based discussions, clinical exploration, and professional development opportunities. 4. Connect - Build meaningful relationships among students, facul

name: Catholic Student Fellowship
description: Catholic Student Fellowship is a student-led, Christ-centered community that strives to cultivate a more just and loving world through community service, Bible studies, and prayer, aiming to create a safe environment where both Catholics and non-Catholics alike can discover and/or build on their faith experience.

name: Chinese Students Association
description: The Chinese Students Association strives to provide a safe and welcoming space for students that are of Chinese, Taiwanese, or Hong Kong origin, or those that are interested in the culture to connect. The association wishes to help students understand and value Chinese culture.

name: Club for Neuroscience Students
description: The purpose of this organization is to relay knowledge and information about the field of neuroscience. This includes information through presentations, volunteer opportunities, research opportunities, and faculty or other guest speakers.

name: College Panhellenic Association
description: The object of the Panhellenic Association shall be to develop and maintain women’s fraternity life and interfraternity relations at a high level of accomplishment, and in so doing to: Promote high academic, social, and moral standards; uphold Panhellenic rules and foster Panhellenic unity.

name: Consulting Club
description: The Consulting Club is a student-led group offering real-world consulting experience through partnerships with local businesses, nonprofits, and student ventures. Members build problem-solving, strategy, and leadership skills while delivering impactful solutions.

name: Craft Club
description: Craft Club is a student organization dedicated to the joys of making arts and crafts! Our main goal is to teach people new, fun skills in a relaxing and casual environment. Craft Club is set up so that every meeting, we learn a new craft.

name: Data Science Association
description: Bridging data science, ML, and AI with real-world impact. We connect students to Bay Area tech through workshops, hackathons, speaker series, and networking events. Build skills. Make connections. Shape the future of data.

name: Delta Delta Delta
description: Delta Delta Delta (Tri Delta) is a sorority that is rooted in truth, self-sacrifice, and friendship! We foster leadership and lifelong sisterhood while supporting our philanthropy, St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, to make a meaningful impact in our community and across the country.

name: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Incorporated
description: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Incorporated is a private, non-profit organization committed to providing support and assistance through community-based programs around the world. Founded on sisterhood, scholarship, and service.

name: Delta Zeta
description: The purpose of this Sorority is to unite its members in bonds of sincere and lasting friendship, to promote their moral and social development, and to foster guidance, unity, and shared action in pursuit of ideals worthy of the highest aims of collective effort.

name: Design Collective
description: Our mission is to connect USF artists and designers with professional opportunities through networking, workshops, portfolio development, industry partnerships, and creative events. We empower students to build meaningful careers while fostering a collaborative and supportive creative community.

name: Economics Student Association
description: The Economics Student Association (ESA) is an inclusive community for undergraduates passionate about economics. Through discussions, speaker series, networking events, hackathons, and outreach, we advance knowledge, explore careers, and foster academic excellence and intellectual curiosity.

name: EIM-OC Ambassadors
description: This organization shall help promote EIM-OC’s mission and events on campus related to physical activity and wellness. The club will aim to offer workshops with local health professionals and USF resources, and host collaborative activities with other student organizations. There will be

name: Entrepreneurship Club
description: The Entrepreneurship Club is a community of student builders and those alike turning ideas into real ventures. We host industry talks, competition-style events, hands-on workshops, and funding opportunities so you can test, launch, and grow your projects in San Francisco’s startup ecosystem.

name: Environmental Engineering and Science Club (EESC)
description: The purpose of this organization is to build community among students interested in Environmental Engineering and Environmental Science by organizing club events, activities, and outings.

name: Ethiopian-Eritrean Students Association (EESA)
description: EESA is a student-led organization dedicated to fostering community, cultural pride, and solidarity among students of East African heritage and their allies. EESA provides a welcoming space where students can celebrate, share traditions, and uplift diverse East African identities.

name: Food Recovery Network
description: The mission of the Food Recovery Network is to reduce food waste by educating on food waste and recovering food for redistribution to those in our community experiencing food insecurity, houselessness, and any other related issues.

name: French Club
description: The French Club provides a safe and supportive environment for all French language learners to practice and improve their French speaking, reading, listening, and writing skills through social and cultural events.

name: Future Clinicians Association (FCA)
description: Our mission is to connect undergraduate psychology majors with resources to explore the different career options within the field of psychology. We intend to hold various workshops and panels to help students feel confident within the field of psychology and in their clinical skills.

name: Game and Strategy Club
description: The purpose of Game and Strategy Club is to unite students who are interested in card and strategic games as a competitive mind sport and a platform for developing strategic thinking, mathematical reasoning, probability analysis, game theory, behavioral psychology, leadership, emotional discipline, and ethical decision-making.Through educational workshops, strategy discussions, friendly competition, guest speakers and networking events by advertising on social media. The organization Game and Strategy Club is committed to promoting responsible decision-making and an informed understanding of g

name: Girl Gains
description: The purpose of Girl Gains is to create an inclusive and empowering community centered around health, wellness, nutrition, self-confidence, and personal growth for students of all backgrounds and identities. The organization seeks to educate and support members through accessible wellness resources, open dialogue, advocacy, and community-building initiatives that encourage balanced lifestyles and positive self-image. Girl Gains is committed to fostering a welcoming environment where all students feel supported in their physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

name: Graphic-Novels: Art and Storytelling (Gravel AS)
description: The purpose of this club is to promote and foster storytelling and creativity among students. We hope to create an environment where individuals can share their literary and artistic works in a group capable of providing both constructive criticism and positive feedback. We also aim to help share any knowledge we have of the subject and assist in improving our artworks and stories in any way. This is essentially a writer’s workshop/book club with an emphasis on comics and our own creations rather than existing works.

name: Hawaiian Ensemble
description: Hawaiian Ensemble is a student-led organization that produces an annual Lūʻau and hosts other events on campus. Students learn cultural traditions through mele Hawai‘i (song), hula (dance), and various forms of Tahitian music and dance (‘ori tahiti).

name: Hilltop Ad Agency
description: The purpose of Hilltop Ad Agency is to provide a space for anyone interested in advertising/marketing to come together and create. The organization functions as an advertising agency, giving students the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the industry.

name: Hilltop Mahjong Club
description: Hilltop Mahjong Club aims to foster an inclusive and welcoming community where students of all backgrounds can learn, play, and appreciate the game of mahjong. The organization is dedicated to promoting mahjong as a game of strategy, culture, and social connection while encouraging friendship and critical thinking.

name: Hilltop Tabletop Club
description: To create a fun and welcoming space where people can gather to discover tabletop games and enjoy a passion for the diverse world of tabletop gaming. We aim to promote teamwork, creativity, critical thinking, respect, and sportsmanship through organized gameplay and community events.

name: Hispanics in STEM Societies (HISS)
description: Hispanics in STEM Societies (HISS) bridges students with professionals and interdisciplinary communities, fostering meaningful connections on and off campus. We collaborate with neighboring universities and industry partners to create distinctive opportunities and inclusive spaces for growth. We’re committed to providing resources that help you discover your community, expand your horizons, and shape a career path that’s uniquely yours.

name: Hive Minders
description: Hive Minders is focused on educating students about bees and pollinators, promoting conservation, and supporting sustainable ecosystems. We host fundraisers, donate to 501(c)(3) organizations, and are transforming the Pollinator Garden and working in the USF Garden.

name: Hui O Hawai'i
description: Hui O Hawai‘i is a cultural organization that celebrates Hawaiian and Tahitian traditions while promoting the Aloha spirit and ‘ohana. We create a welcoming space for students to connect, learn, and share culture through social, educational, and cultural events, including our annual Hōʻike.

name: Indian Student Organization (ISO)
description: Indian Student Organization (ISO) builds a welcoming community for students to celebrate Indian traditions, festivals, and culture. We create a home away from home, foster belonging and friendships, and host inclusive events open to all who want to experience and appreciate Indian culture.

name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)
description: We are affiliated with an international organization of electrical engineers. We focus on building a community among all stem peoples and stoking interest in the field of electrical engineering.

name: International Student Association (ISA)
description: ISA serves to promote cultural education, advocate for the international student body, provide a social community, create social interaction, and develop educational opportunities for cultural enrichment.

name: InterVarsity Christian Fellowship
description: InterVarsity Christian Fellowship is a welcoming spiritual community where students explore faith, build authentic friendships, and grow in their relationship with God. Our mission is to guide students in discovering their purpose, deepening their spirituality, and living out faith in everyday life.

name: Iranian Student Union
description: The Iranian Student Union fosters community, cultural awareness, and connection among students. Through social, cultural, and educational events, we celebrate Iranian heritage, promote cross-cultural understanding, and create an inclusive space for all members of the community.

name: Japanese Student Association
description: JSA is dedicated to promoting Japanese culture and fostering a welcoming community. Through cultural events, social gatherings, and collaborations, JSA provides students with opportunities to explore Japanese traditions, build friendships, and engage with both Japanese communities.

name: Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Incorporated
description: Kappa Alpha Psi’s mission and purpose are to promote achievement in every field of human endeavor, uphold high moral and ethical standards, foster leadership and brotherhood, and provide meaningful service to communities.

name: Kappa Alpha Theta
description: Kappa Alpha Theta is a nationally recognized social sorority committed to service, scholarship, personal excellence, and sisterhood. Through our shared values sisters are able to find community and build friendships to last beyond their time at USF.

name: Kasamahan
description: Kasamahan is Filipina/x/o and Filipina/x/o-American Student Organization committed to foster unity and solidarity of the Filipina/x/o and Filipina/x/o-American community while striving to share, encourage participation, and educate others of the Filipino culture.

name: Kesem San Francisco
description: The purpose of Kesem SF is to support children in the San Francisco community who are impacted by a parent’s cancer by providing free, year-round programming, including Camp Kesem. Through service, fundraising, and outreach, we strive to ensure that every child feels supported and never alone. Our organization is guided by the values of empathy, resilience, accountability, continuous learning, and inclusivity while fostering leadership and community service among college students.

name: Kinesiology Student Association (KSA)
description: The purpose of the Kinesiology Student Association is to advance the knowledge of future Kinesiology professionals and form a bond with the community and its members. Members of this association shall participate in service to better society and shall become educated on understanding human movement.

name: Lambda Pi Eta (LPE)
description: Lambda Pi Eta is a communication honors society, promoting excellence through events, leadership, and professional growth. Members must have a 3.25 major GPA, 3.0 cumulative GPA, and 60+ units completed. Join us to connect, lead, and thrive in communication studies!

name: Latinas Unidas (LU)
description: The purpose of Latinas Unidas shall be to create opportunities for social and academic success for Latine identifying students and those interested in Latine culture to create understanding, spur civic action, and strengthen community engagement. LU strives to connect members to campus and the broader Bay Area community with the goal of affirming our standing in higher education and advocate for highlighting the Latine experience for all students.

name: Latine Nursing Student Association
description: Latine Nursing Student Association is a student-formed and student led organization created to become a safe space for Latine students and those interested in supporting this population. Through advocacy, education, and networking opportunities, we aim to address the unique challenges faced by Latine individuals in the nursing and healthcare.

name: Latine Student Union (LSU)
description: The mission of the Latine Student Union is to create a welcoming and supportive space that feels safe and open to all students. While centering the experiences of Latine students and those interested in Latine culture, we embrace and honor everyone’s ability to show up authentically. We foster confidence by valuing each person’s unique experiences and supporting students as they explore their identities throughout their collegiate journey.

name: Latine Undergrad Network of Activists (L.U.N.A)
description: The purpose of L.U.N.A is to empower the Latine community through educational, cultural, economic, political, and social engagement, fostering pride, advocacy, and collective growth while welcoming all who support our mission.

name: Male Student Nurses Society (MSNS)
description: The purpose of this organization is to examine the influence of gender in the nursing profession. Through active involvement in volunteerism and activities both on and off campus, this organization strives to develop community, leadership, and professional skills.

name: Minority Association of Pre-Medical Students (MAPS)
description: Provide underrepresented pre-medical students with knowledge and skills in relation to professional involvement in the field of health care. The goal of the organization is to help improve minority student matriculation into all professional health related programs (with an emphasis on medicine).

name: Model United Nations (MUN)
description: USF MUN is a dynamic student organization focused on diplomacy, debate, and global issues. Our mission is to develop confident speakers, critical thinkers, and future leaders through engaging simulations, conferences, and a supportive, inclusive community.

name: Muslim Student Association
description: Our organization was created to give muslim students and students with interest in the religion a space to connect and feel welcomed.

name: Narcare
description: Narcare at USF is a student-led nonprofit focused on harm reduction and opioid overdose prevention. We educate about drug overdose, distribute naloxone, and partner with the community to reduce stigma and promote health equity through advocacy, outreach, and training.

name: National Organization of Minority Architecture Students (NOMAS)
description: NOMAS empowers underrepresented architecture students through mentorship, networking, professional development, community outreach, and academic support. Our mission is to increase diversity in the AEC industry by preparing students to excel academically and professionally.

name: National Society of Black Engineers (NSBE)
description: The purpose of this organization is to serve, stimulate and develop student interest in engineering; to strive to promote participation at all levels of responsibility in the field of engineering for Black communities, and to promote the advancement of Black professional engineers within the individual engineering disciplines.

name: National Society of Leadership and Success (NSLS)
description: The NSLS is an organization that provides a life-changing leadership program that helps students achieve personal growth and career success and empowers them to have a positive impact in their communities.We build leaders, support people in achieving their goals, and improve the world in the process

name: National Student Nurses' Association - Sacramento
description: The purpose of NSNA-Sac is to embody and advance the vision and mission of the University by cultivating a community of accountable and responsible future nursing leaders. We strive to support the success of nursing students through mentorship, advocacy, and the promotion of values that inspire us to be men and women for others. Our commitment extends to contributing to nursing education, ensuring the highest standards of healthcare, and introducing students to their first professional organization at local, state, and national levels, all while aligning with the University's Catholic, Jesuit

name: Nepalese Heritage Association
description: Our organization strives to celebrate and honor Nepalese culture. It creates a space for Nepalese students and those interested in Nepalese culture where they can share experiences and learn from one another. Our mission is to educate our community on Nepalese society and culture.

name: Neurodiversity Social Club
description: The Neurodiversity Social Club exists with the selective purpose of being a safe and comfortable environment for all neurodivergent-questioning and neurodivergent-identifying students, as well as all allies of neurodivergent students.

name: Nursing Students' Association
description: Our mission is to reshape and serve as a change in the world by establishing a sense of community from within. Our organization will use the platform that has been created to propel ourselves and become a bigger voice for those who are underrepresented in healthcare services.

name: Omega Psi Phi Fraternity, Incorporated
description: To unite college men of high ideals of scholarship and manhood, stimulating their ambitions, occupying a constructive place in civic and political life, and assisting downtrodden humanity in its efforts to achieve a higher social, economic, and intellectual status.

name: Option, Futures, Financial Derivatives
description: We educate students on options, futures, and financial derivatives through hands-on workshops and a collaborative paper trading portfolio. Members learn pricing theory, hedging strategies, and risk management while developing quantitative skills for careers in trading and finance.

name: Organization of Engineering Students (OES)
description: The Organization of Engineering Students is dedicated to fostering an inclusive community that supports academic and professional growth. We connect members with resources and opportunities while hosting events and competitions that encourage unity, collaboration, innovation, and real-world impact.

name: Pakistan Student Union
description: The Pakistan Student Union builds a community for Pakistani students and welcomes all who are interested in Pakistani culture. We promote cultural exchange through music, traditions, food, and events, creating a home-away-from-home and fostering connection, inclusion, and understanding on campus.

name: Palestinian Student Association
description: The Palestinian Student Association fosters Palestinian community identity through cultural events, educational seminars, and community outreach, welcoming all students interested in engaging with Palestinian culture, history, and current events.

name: Pediatric Hematology & Oncology Student Association
description: PHOSA exists to build a community of future healthcare professionals dedicated to advancing pediatric hematology and oncology through education, mentorship, advocacy, and service. We are committed to cultivating leaders who provide compassionate, family-centered care and advocate for children and families throughout every stage of their healthcare journey.

name: PERIOD
description: We are a chapter of PERIOD. The Menstrual Movement working to end period poverty and stigma through service, education, and advocacy.

name: Philosophy Club
description: Philosophy Club is a place for any student who is interested in philosophy to explore a vast range of topics in a casual and friendly setting outside the classroom. Each week we cover new questions in a discussion suggested and led by a different member every week. No background information or experience necessary.

name: Pre-American Medical Student Association (Pre-AMSA)
description: Pre-AMSA offers students helpful info and opportunities to prepare for medical school and guidance in their journeys in the healthcare field, while prioritizing community service, fundraising, educational enrichment, career development, leadership, networking, and community bonding.

name: Pre-Dental Society
description: Pre-Dental Society provides support, resources, and community for students interested in pursuing a career in dentistry. The organization aims to offer professional development opportunities, informational workshops, volunteer experiences, and networking events for members.

name: Pre-Health Peer Mentor Program
description: PPMP is all about growth, connection, and success. We match mentees with inspiring mentors who share guidance, support, and real-world advice to help you thrive. From mentorship sessions to guest speakers such as healthcare workers, we're here to share advice and opportunity.

name: Pre-Physician Assistant Society
description: The Pre-PA Society supports students interested in the Physician Assistant path through mentorship, guest speakers, networking, volunteer opportunities, and academic guidance. Our mission is to build a supportive community that helps students grow professionally and personally.

name: Promoting Animal Welfare through Service (P.A.W.S.)
description: The main purpose of this organization is to raise awareness of the injustices of animal cruelty. Our members must be committed to bringing forth the issues of animal welfare and spreading this idea to the rest of our USF community.

name: Psi Chi
description: Recognizing and promoting excellence in the science and application of psychology. Psi Chi is an international honor society whose purpose shall be to encourage, stimulate, and maintain excellence in scholarship of the individual members in all fields, particularly in psychology.

name: Psychology Student Association
description: The Psychology Student Association is a student-led initiative to contribute to community within the Psychology Department. We strive to include all psychology majors and members of our department to facilitate connection and engagement within student life.

name: Public Health Society
description: The Public Health Society is dedicated to advancing health equity and community well-being. Our mission is to engage students in public health through service, education, and advocacy, while fostering a passion for addressing health disparities locally and globally.

name: Public Relations Student Society of America (PRSSA)
description: To cultivate a community for students interested in public relations, communications, marketing, advertising, and other fields by providing professional development, networking opportunities, and hands on experience. Our purpose is to bridge the gap between classroom learning and industry practices.

name: Qmmunity
description: We are an organization dedicated to providing a space for students to share meals and discuss topics related to queerness and those interested in queer issues and current events.

name: QUARTZ
description: QUARTZ is a dance group that strives to provide a judgment-free space where people are allowed to express themselves through passionate performance, build community with others who share similar interests (I.E: kpop, jpop, international pop, dance, etc.), and ultimately…have fun!

name: Residence Hall Association (RHA)
description: RHA is an active presence on campus that aims to serve as a voice for residents. The organization accomplishes this by providing leadership opportunities within residence halls, planning and executing Program that seek to provide a positive on campus living experience, and serve as a liaison between

name: San Francisco Dons Marching Band
description: The San Francisco Dons Marching Band promotes school spirit and provides energetic performances at athletic games, parades, and community events. SFDMB fosters musical development, leadership, and meaningful connections in a vibrant student-run organization.

name: San Francisco Hillel
description: The purpose of this organization is to engage its members in an enriched social and cultural life based on Jewish values, cultures and identities.

name: San Francisco Young Democrats on Hilltop
description: San Francisco Young Democrats on Hilltop aims to actively support issues, initiatives, and candidates of the Democratic Party that help student interests. Our organization serves to empower undergraduate students to make their voices heard and valued through community engagement, activism opportunities, and networking events.

name: Scrappy Journalers: Junk Journal Club
description: To provide a creative space where students can enjoy their hoppy of junk journaling with other enthusiasts. To support the ideals of “reduce, reuse, and recycle” through the utilization of materials that would otherwise be thrown away. To foster a sense of community through a shared interest.

name: SF AI Club
description: SF AI is a student organization dedicated to exploring artificial intelligence through hands on projects, workshops, and industry events. Our mission is to build technical skills, foster collaboration, and connect students with real world AI applications and career opportunities.

name: SF Leo-Lion Club
description: The SF Leo-Lion Club empowers students to become leaders by serving their communities in ways that are meaningful to them. Rooted in the values of Lions International, our mission is to build a space where individuals can create service projects centered around their passions or potential interests.

name: Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Incorporated
description: It is the mission of Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Inc. to enhance the quality of life for women and their families in the U.S. and globally through community service, civil, and social action. Our goal is to achieve greater progress in the areas of education, health awareness, and leadership development. Our members, affiliates, staff, and community partners work to create and support initiatives that align with our vision.

name: Sister Connection
description: The purpose of our organization is to foster a community that is dedicated to uplifting and supporting students. This organization values healing, self-reflection, growth, self-care, as well as mutual empowerment and support.

name: Society of Architecture Students
description: Society of Architecture Students welcomes all new students who are interested in architecture and getting to know their fellow cohort. We want to create a community for everyone to socialize outside of our regular studies.

name: Society of First-Generation Students
description: The purpose of SFGS is to enable students of all years and all majors to succeed. With a special interest in supporting first-generation-identifying students, and allies, we host year-round events and provide opportunities to bring together the wider community.

name: Society of Women Engineers (SWE)
description: SWE is dedicated to empowering students in Engineering and other STEM-related fields in their prospective careers while offering professional help, advice, and connections.

name: Sports Business Club
description: The Sports Business Club connects students interested in the sports industry through networking, professional development, and hands-on learning. Our mission is to help members explore careers in sports marketing, analytics, media, operations, and athlete representation.

name: Strategic Tactics and Resources for Thinkers (START)
description: START empowers students to explore economics, innovation, and urban development through mentorship, workshops, and other resources. Our mission is to develop ethical leaders who solve real-world challenges through business, technology, economic strategy, and collaboration.

name: Strategies for Ecology Education, Diversity, and Sustainability (SEEDS)
description: Strategies for Ecology Education, Diversity and Sustainability (SEEDS), is an organization dedicated to creating opportunities for students interested in ecology to gain knowledge and experience within the field of environmental science and sustainability.

name: Student Alumni Association
description: The Student Alumni Association connects students and alumni to build mentorship, pride, and lifelong support for the University. Through philanthropy, engagement, and shared traditions, we help students leave a lasting legacy and strengthen the University community.

name: Student Investment Club
description: The Student Investment Club is a fully student-led organization that acts as a community for members of all backgrounds and experience levels seeking personal finance support and financial services industry career development. We seek to bridge the gap between the University, FiDi, Wall St, and Silicon Valley.

name: Students for Israel Association
description: The Students for Israel Association celebrates Jewish and Israeli culture as a welcoming community for students. Our progressive values include promoting peace, advocacy for Israel, advocating to improve Israel’s current state, and combating antisemitism. This association is meant to be a community where students feel safe exploring these topics.

name: Supporting Immigrants and Refugees Club (SIRC)
description: SIRC strives to create meaningful change by supporting communities impacted by anti-immigration policies and engaging students from all backgrounds. We provide opportunities to get involved with our communities through volunteering, fundraising, advocacy, and partnerships with local nonprofits.

name: Tech and Business Society (TABS)
description: TABS (Tech and Business Society) empowers students to explore the intersection of technology and business through hands-on projects, networking, workshops, and collaboration. We welcome students of all majors and experience levels to learn, innovate, and grow together.

name: Thai Student Union
description: The Thai Student Union is a vibrant and inclusive community dedicated to celebrating and promoting Thai culture among students. Open to anyone with an interest in Thailand’s rich traditions, the organization provides a welcoming space for individuals to connect, learn, and engage with one another.

name: The Flow State Chess Club
description: The Flow State Chess Club's goal is to promote the game of chess as a meditative strategy and intellectual exercise for any and all students. As well as to harbor an open and supportive environment of those who wish to learn, play, and enjoy the game of chess.

name: The Hospitality Society (THS)
description: Our club bridges the gap between student life and the professional world. THS provides industry knowledge, enriching experiences, and networking opportunities. THS actively strives to form a supportive environment that promotes creating connections to help make the future leaders of any industry.

name: The Marketing Club
description: The Marketing Club aims to unite a community of students with a shared interest in marketing. We do this by hosting workshops, panels with marketing and business professionals, and other events that provide meaningful learning opportunities.

name: Transfer Student Alliance
description: The Transfer Student Alliance advocates for transfer students by promoting education and campus involvement. The club provides a community for all students interested in it, including mentorship, resource connections, events, and a sense of belonging.

name: Tri Gamma Women's Nursing Society
description: Tri-Gamma was established under the School of Nursing and Health Professions under “Goodness, Graciousness, and Generosity.” Since 1948, the members of Tri-Gamma have worked to uphold these values through community service, academic achievement, and friendship.

name: Tri-Beta National Biological Honor Society
description: Tri-Beta is a national biological honor society dedicated to promoting scholarship, research, and service in the life sciences. Our mission is to support students passionate about biology through academic excellence, community engagement, and opportunities for research and collaboration.

name: Undergraduate Law Society
description: The purpose of the Undergraduate Law Society is to prepare and provide resources to students exploring and pursuing a future career in law. We seek to create an inclusive community where students can grow together, forming a more unified legal network.

name: UNICEF Club
description: UNICEF raises awareness about global issues affecting children, advocates for their rights, and supports UNICEF’s programs. We engage students through events, campaigns, and service to promote equity, compassion, and a better future for children worldwide.

name: United Students for Veterans' Health
description: USVH strives to help long-term care patients in Veterans Affairs (VA) hospitals by bringing student volunteers to engage the Veterans. The primary goal of USVH is to connect with veterans and to make them feel appreciated through service and community.

name: Veterans Club
description: To facilitate engagement, support, representation, benefit knowledge, and opportunity for veterans, family of veterans, and those interested in serving in the United States military.

name: Vietnamese Student Association (VSA)
description: VSA is culturally focused club that aims to unite the international and domestic Vietnamese population. We aim to be a club where people can feel comfortable expressing and learning about Vietnamese Culture. Our club is open to everyone regardless of race. Just come in with an open heart!

name: Women in Finance
description: Women in Finance is dedicated to empowering the next generation of women to confidently navigate and lead in the world of finance. We strive to create an inclusive, supportive community that fosters professional growth, financial literacy, and meaningful connections.

name: Women in Pre-Medicine Society
description: The purpose of the Women in Pre-Medicine Society is to build community, sisterhood, and lifelong connections for pre-medical students on campus.

name: Women in Psychology
description: Women in Psychology creates opportunities for academic and personal growth through an inclusive, supportive community. We empower students, especially women in psych, through networking, resources, and open discussions in a safe, non-competitive environment.

name: Women in Technology (WiT)
description: We celebrate and support women and minorities pursuing careers in technology. Dedicated to building a strong, supportive community for growth and development, providing valuable opportunities for academic and professional success. While our focus is on uplifting women in tech, we welcome all.

name: Women's Chemical Society
description: The purpose of the Women’s Chemical Society is to foster a supportive and inclusive community for students interested in chemistry and related sciences, particularly women.
